intents.name: Delivery problem
intents.description: Problems with an order's delivery, including late, missing, delayed, misdelivered, or carrier-related shipments.
exclude: customer wants to cancel an order
customer wants a refund after receiving an item

intents.name: Order management
intents.description: Issues involving creating, changing, cancelling, tracking the state of, or otherwise managing an order.

intents.name: Returns and refunds
intents.description: Requests or problems involving returning products, receiving refunds, refund timing, or refund method.
exclude: delivery delay without a refund request

intents.name: Payment and charges
intents.description: Problems involving payment methods, charges, cash on delivery, card payments, or unexpected/duplicate charges.
exclude: promotion eligibility unless the issue is specifically payment

intents.name: Account access and security
intents.description: Problems accessing or securing an Amazon account.

intents.name: Product problem
intents.description: Problems with a physical product after ordering or receiving it.
exclude: refund-only issue without a product problem

intents.name: Prime Video and digital content
intents.description: Technical or availability issues involving Prime Video or Amazon digital video/content.

intents.name: Seller and marketplace
intents.description: Problems involving third-party sellers, marketplace purchases, seller communication, seller disputes, or A-to-z claims.

intents.name: Promotions, deals and cashback
intents.description: Questions or problems involving promotional offers, discounts, deals, coupons, or cashback.

intents.name: Prime membership
intents.description: Questions or problems specifically about Prime membership rather than Prime shipping or Prime Video.

intents.name: Customer service and escalation
intents.description: Existing support cases where the customer primarily reports poor support, repeated unresolved contact, or requests escalation.
include: previous agent did not resolve issue
case has been unresolved for a long time
exclude: a new issue with a clear underlying intent
simple delivery complaint unless the main complaint is unresolved support

intents.name: Other or unclear
intents.description: Amazon-related customer message that cannot be confidently assigned to another intent.
include: feedback without a clear support problem
